name: Mermaid CLI
description: Mermaid CLI is a local command-line tool that renders Mermaid diagrams, not a hosted API.
auth_notes: No credentials are involved; the tool runs locally via npm or Docker. The MERMAID reef-data API in the sources is an unrelated product.
gate_detail: Install and run locally with no account or credentials. There is no hosted first-party API to obtain credentials for.
api_scope: Local diagram rendering through the mmdc command line and a Node.js API that is not covered by semver; no hosted endpoints.
mcp_notes: A Mermaid MCP server exists at mermaid.ai for the hosted Mermaid product, but sources do not tie it to the mermaid-cli repository.
blocker_detail: The hinted product is a local CLI and Node.js library, so there is no hosted first-party API to integrate against.
